issues.text: A7 says CHANGED/PAGES of public-build stay because «the new pages have no region»; decisions/0137 Addition 3 gives each account page one kk region, which the open build cuts, so PB-2 was red on bddef13 (the files that differ included the four pages) — not in the developers' expected-red list. The four pages joined CHANGED and the region-cut comparison of PB-2 with a «kk region only» check; likewise A8 needed PP-2's script rule to name each account page's own module (/js/pages/<page>.js) and PP-7's built page list to gain the four. No rule was loosened; each widens a list to the new files.

A9 (forbidden-words page lists the six → + the four): the file holds no literal page list; its real-files case (FW-7) runs check-public, which reads every page of app/public, so the four pages are already covered. No edit.

app/test/unit/route-table.test.js has two writers in sequence: the auth lane created it with RT-6 and a header naming RT-1 … RT-5 as the tenancy lane's; I appended RT-1..RT-5 once at the end (their 6432 bytes byte-equal before and after, imports done inside my block). If the auth lane rewrites the file, RT-1..RT-5 must stay (RT-3 is invariant row 11 of docs/security-invariants.md, SI-1).
unit/db-calls.test.js (DBC-1..3, REQ-115 c4, design 9.2) was not in the handoff's explicit file list but is a 9.2 file no lane named; written here.

M48b (the grants step's BEGIN and COMMIT removed, the file still sent as one exec) survives and is equivalent: one simple-protocol message with several statements runs as one implicit transaction on Postgres and on PGlite, so a failure still leaves no grant. M48 as the design states it (half the grants applied) is the statement-by-statement form, killed by MG-6 (c).

Added beyond the named cases, by the 02b test lines: TXH-6 (SEC F1: appendAudit under tenant settings throws before the chain lock, audit_log unchanged; also in AC-3 on pg) and CIW-3 (REVIEWER F1: the $do$ block raises on an empty public table, run on PGlite). A11 docker-files and A21 import-boundaries were run unchanged and are green on bddef13.
SI-1 is green only with both lanes' files in the tree (it was red while RT-3 was missing); NPM-5 likewise needs the auth lane's 14 int and 1 pg files.
